description: Header file defining the ConvolutionFilter1D class and related functions for 2D and 1D convolution operations in the skia graphics library, including SIMD optimizations and Gaussian kernel setup.

classes.name: ConvolutionFilter1D
classes.description: Represents a one-dimensional convolution filter used in 2D convolution operations.

methods.name: FloatToFixed
methods.description: Converts a float to fixed point representation.

methods.name: FixedToChar
methods.description: Converts a fixed point value to an unsigned char.

methods.name: FixedToFloat
methods.description: Converts a fixed point value to float.

methods.name: AddFilter
methods.description: Adds a filter to the convolution filter list, either from float values or fixed point values.

methods.name: FilterForValue
methods.description: Retrieves the filter coefficients for a specific output pixel position.

methods.name: GetSingleFilter
methods.description: Retrieves the single filter used for convolution when only one filter is applied.

methods.name: PaddingForSIMD
methods.description: Adds padding to filter values to prevent SIMD memory access issues.

methods.name: BGRAConvolve2D
methods.description: Performs a 2D convolution on BGRA image data.

methods.name: SingleChannelConvolveX1D
methods.description: Performs a 1D convolution along the X axis on a single image channel.

methods.name: SingleChannelConvolveY1D
methods.description: Performs a 1D convolution along the Y axis on a single image channel.

methods.name: SetUpGaussianConvolutionKernel
methods.description: Initializes a convolution filter with a Gaussian kernel.
